summary: Run and enforce critical K, fixed-price and activation tests in Fast CI
details: Expand the Ethash test filter to include the independent 50405-step K oracle, K and fixed-price transition tests, and expected-version activation-boundary validation.
Require manifest-listed tests to run and pass in actual Go JSON reports for the default and all three conformance builds; omitted, renamed, skipped or incomplete tests fail the gate.
Check that critical test families remain registered and selected without changing world-sim round counts or protocol behavior.
